question: Can I sacrifice more than one artifact, enchantment or token to pay a spell's bargain cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you may sacrifice only one artifact, enchantment or token to pay a spell's bargain cost.
expected.answer: You may sacrifice only one artifact, enchantment, or token to pay a spell's bargain cost.
